title: 2026 international maritime ice-class no-5%-reduction proposal QA

sources.title: UK ETS international maritime voyages consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS scope expansion: maritime sector

facts.source_fact: The consultation acknowledges the EU ETS ice-class vessel policy.
The EU ETS policy described allows qualifying ice-class ships to surrender 5% fewer allowances until 31 December 2030.
The UK ETS Authority states that it is not currently intending to introduce the same 5% reduction.
The Authority is nevertheless seeking stakeholder views on whether adjustments are needed for ice-class ships.
The question is considered in the context of proposed international maritime expansion.
The proposed international expansion is targeted for 2028.
The consultation separately asks whether other ship types need scope adjustments.
The UK position described is an intention in consultation, not a final enacted ice-class rule.
The EU 5% reduction is used as a comparator, not as a current UK ETS entitlement.
No allowance reduction should be inferred for a UK ship solely because it is ice class.
